decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits squarely within the firm's pipeline-fittings expertise, so it can read customer feedback and refine the product with existing welding and testing know-how.

The powder-coated public waste bin is distant from the core business, but it reuses the firm's coating and sheet-metal fabrication skills and serves the same municipal customers, giving enough related knowledge to keep it for now.

The waste bin with ashtray line relies on the same coating and fabrication capabilities and municipal channels, but its several models stretch limited related knowledge, making this a borderline keep.

The outdoor ashtray line is the furthest from the pipeline core, offers little the firm can learn back into its infrastructure business, and lacks R&D support, so its resources are better returned to established products.
